question: Schengen 90/180 rule — explain in one paragraph.
expected: You may spend at most 90 days in any rolling 180-day window across the Schengen Area on a short-stay visa or visa-waiver. Calculation is per entry-day, not per visit.  Re-entry after exhausting 90 requires the 90-day pool to refill by ageing-out previous days.

question: Why does altitude sickness onset differ across people?
